scenarios.title: List all active positions with current P&L
scenarios.event: User asks for current portfolio status
scenarios.expectedAction: Fetch positions, calculate unrealized P&L for each, display summary table

scenarios.title: Calculate FIFO P&L across multiple trades
scenarios.event: User has bought and sold the same token multiple times
scenarios.expectedAction: Apply FIFO accounting to calculate accurate realized P&L

scenarios.title: Generate risk score showing overconcentration
scenarios.event: User has 80% of portfolio in one market
scenarios.expectedAction: Calculate high risk score, warn about concentration risk

scenarios.title: No open positions
scenarios.event: User checks portfolio but has no active positions
scenarios.expectedAction: Report zero positions with historical P&L if available

scenarios.title: Position in resolved market still shows
scenarios.event: Market has resolved but tokens haven't been redeemed
scenarios.expectedAction: Flag position as redeemable, show redemption value vs current book value

criteria: Positions accurately reflect on-chain state: Does the skill correctly fetch and display all active positions?
FIFO P&L calculation is mathematically correct: Does the skill apply FIFO cost basis properly?
Risk score reflects portfolio concentration and exposure: Does the risk scoring capture real portfolio risk?
Safety limit utilization reported accurately: Does the skill show how close to limits the portfolio is?
Export format is structured and complete: Does the JSON export include all necessary data?
